title: Reject high-interest niches without paid intent proof
purpose: Verify that niche discovery prioritizes payment evidence over general interest, trendiness, or search volume.
prompt: Find 5 AI niche opportunities for a Polish AI community and business app studio. Include one idea that looks popular but lacks evidence people pay. Make a build/test/watch/reject decision for each.
expected_behaviors: Uses paid intent proof as the highest-weighted factor.
Separates search/community interest from evidence of budgets, purchases, ads, tools, consultants, jobs, or existing spend.
Adapts global patterns to Polish SMBs, creators, communities, or content-led businesses.
Outputs a table with niche, buyer, problem, proof they pay, existing solutions, gap, AI app, YouTube angle, lead magnet, paid offer, score, and decision.
Marks the popular but unpaid idea as watch or reject instead of build.
failure_patterns: Ranks ideas mainly by excitement or trendiness.
Treats search volume as proof of willingness to pay.
Returns generic startup ideas without a buyer, offer, or monetization path.
judge_notes: Passing output must make at least one explicit rejection based on weak paid intent.
